cards.title: Main Rail
items: Five ordered phases carry the spec from Open Questions to shipped code
Approved is a human gate, not an automatic step
The docs-delta gate runs before every git mv, not only at a happy-path finish

cards.title: Recovery Loop
items: A depth eval can return inconclusive instead of green
That re-opens the deferred decision rather than silently shipping
Grounded in the prompt-anchor case: Phase 5 was inconclusive on 2026-07-18, so D3 triggered and the hook never shipped

cards.title: Alternate Closure
items: A spec can be superseded by a newer one instead of implemented
Superseded specs still pass the docs-delta gate before their git mv
git mv to archived/ preserves history; the file becomes read-only context after that
